game_flow_notes.note: Teams printing NOT YET SUBMITTED in the 08:00 PM edition: ['Chicago Bulls', 'Cleveland Cavaliers', 'Memphis Grizzlies', 'Miami Heat', 'New Orleans Pelicans']. Teams on the second night of a back-to-back on 11/14 per the official schedule: []. Policy: second-game reports are due by 1 p.m. local on game day. The two lists are published side by side without being equated.

Portland and Minnesota play each other at Target Center on BOTH 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17 (per the official schedule), so both enter 11/17 on the second night of a back-to-back; their 11/17 reports are due by 1 p.m. local on game day and were not yet published at capture.

Dallas plays 11/14 (at Cleveland) and 11/15 (at Boston) — a back-to-back; Boston plays 11/15 and 11/16; Washington plays 11/15 and 11/16. Second-game reports for these are due by 1 p.m. local on game day and were not yet published at capture.

flags.detail: The 2026-11-13 games were IN PROGRESS at build time (01:00–01:25 UTC = 8:00–8:25 PM ET). No 11/13 final existed yet, so every horizon game uses pre-11/13 records, and teams that played 11/13 are missing one result. Picks regenerate automatically when finals exist (python3 scripts/generate_picks_d.py after capturing finals). This is a data-currency limit, disclosed per row via records_as_of — not a claim of current strength.

flags.flag: Injury reports for 11/15–11/17 not yet published
flags.detail: Per the official 2026-27 policy, next-day reports are due by 5 p.m. local the day before (1 p.m. local for second games of back-to-backs). At capture (11/13 08:00 PM edition) no 11/15–11/17 rows existed. Record-based lines for those dates carry NO injury adjustment; the gap is disclosed per game, never filled.

flags.flag: 5 rows in the 08:00 PM PDF lost their team cell
flags.detail: PDF text extraction drops cells on continuation rows. Rows whose team/matchup/date cannot be carried from an earlier official edition (12:00 PM / 05:15 PM) are kept in unattributed_rows with the verbatim markdown beside them, and are used in NO signal.

The 12:00 PM edition printed him with LA Clippers (11/13, OKC@LAC); the 05:15 PM edition's 11/14 row printed a Cleveland team cell (its own extraction note calls this ambiguous); the 08:00 PM edition prints him in the Dallas continuation block with the cell lost. Team left blank; row excluded from all signals; manual review required.

Smoothing +3/+6, HCA 2.5, K 35, SIGMA 11, pick gate 3.0 are this project's documented assumptions (lineage flag E-01), not official values. Home-court advantage could not be sourced from an official NBA page; 2.5 is an assumption carried from Build A.

RecordLine-1 uses records only and cannot separate pace/efficiency, so game totals are not published (same limit as Build A's lines.html). Totals would need the ratings-based engine in scripts/originate_lines.py fed with current stats.

flags.flag: Market gates G4/G5 remain blocked; 0 strategies funded
flags.detail: No odds feed is connected, so closing-line-value and economic-value gates cannot run. Every pick on this page is a paper record; the leaderboard (Build B) still shows 0 funded strategies, and this build changes nothing about that.

flags.flag: 11/15 and 11/16 schedule rows rely on Build C's verified capture
flags.detail: This session re-verified 11/14 and 11/17 rows against fresh NBA.com captures (10/10 match). The 11/15 (9 games) and 11/16 (8 games) rows were verified row-by-row by Build C on 2026-11-14 (data/raw/verification_c03.json, 0 mismatches) and are not re-fetched here.

flags.flag: Leader stats are season averages through 11/12
flags.detail: Team-leader PPG/RPG/APG come from official game-card 'Season Leaders' captured 11/13 (leaders.json) or in this build's fresh captures. Pages fetched while 11/13 games were in progress still display through-11/12 values. Three blanks (CHA/LAL/TOR) were filled from the fresh 11/17 capture, with source links per row.

flags.flag: Injury statuses are not minutes or production forecasts
flags.detail: A report status constrains availability only. No verified minutes history exists for the listed players, so no rotation-minute or production number is derived (consistent with Build A's gameflow layer). Impact stays qualitative; the per-team Out/Questionable counts and leader status are published without a numeric shift.

flags.flag: Injury-report game-time column differs from the schedule for DET@MIA (07:00 (ET) vs 8:00 PM ET)
flags.detail: Both are official values. The schedule tip is used for display; the report value is preserved verbatim in data/raw/d/injury_report_2026-11-13_08_00PM.json. Flagged for manual review rather than silently reconciled.
